Class WindowLayout

java.lang.Object
guiLessonSupport.WindowLayout
public final class WindowLayout extends Object
KG06 consistent breadcrumb, bold title, labeled card, blue primary action, red destructive action and Back/Logout/Quit footer. Labels use labelFor for keyboard/accessibility support.
